title: CliOutput
description: The format for all messages written to stdout by the CLI

oneOf.description: Data that is output at the end of a command.
Status update output as a command progresses.
Additional warnings, such as for an outdated Python dependency.

BrowserTestSpec.description:
In-browser test spec from the `tmc` exercise service: the script to
run in the client plus an optional error set when the build failed.

ChapterLockingStatus.description:
Where the user is in a course's chapter locking, which opens chapters one at a time as the
previous ones are completed.

oneOf.description: The chapter's exercises can be submitted to.
The user has completed the chapter and locked it; its exercises take no more submissions.
The previous chapters must be completed first.

ClientUpdateData.description: The update data type for the progress reporter.

ClosedChapter.description: A chapter of the course that opens later, with the user's progress on its exercises.

chapter_number.description: The chapter's position in the course, from 1.

CombinedMoocCourseData.description:
A mooc course, its exercise slides and the current user's progress in it,
fetched together. The mooc counterpart of [`CombinedCourseData`].

ConfigValue.description: A setting in a TmcConfig file.

CourseAiPolicy.description:
A course's AI-use policy as chosen by its teacher, uninterpreted: what each value permits
is the client's decision.

oneOf.description: The teacher has not chosen a policy.
AI may not be used at any point.
AI may be used for planning, such as brainstorming or outlining, but not in the final work.
AI may be used for specific tasks only, with disclosure.
AI may be used freely, with disclosure.
AI use is expected.
A value newer than this client.

CourseProgress.description:
The current user's progress across every exercise they can see in a course.
Course-level totals (awarded/available points, passed count, percentage) are
not sent separately; derive them by summing over `exercises`, guarding the
percentage against a zero total.

closed_chapters.description:
Chapters that have not opened yet. Their exercises are missing from `exercises` and
from the course's exercise list until then; they are closed, not removed.

CourseRefusalKind.description:
How courses.mooc.fi refused one course. The values are the CLI error kinds the same response
fails a single-course command with.

oneOf.description: A 403 `insufficient_scope`: the session lacks the `exercise-services` scope.
Any other 403: the user may not view the course, e.g. a draft.
A 404: the course does not exist, or not for this user.

http_status.description: The HTTP status a server answered with, when the error is one.

path.description: The file or folder a file-system error concerns.

request_id.description: The id courses.mooc.fi logged the failed request under, for support.

retry_after_secs.description: How long the server asked to wait before trying again, in seconds.

oneOf.description: megabytes

failed.description: Each failure with its error chain, outermost first, and why it failed.
Each failure with its error chain, outermost first, and why it failed.

ExerciseChapter.description:
The chapter an exercise belongs to, for grouping a course's exercises the way its material
does.

chapter_number.description: The chapter's position in the course, from 1.

locking_status.description:
The user's status in the course's chapter locking; submissions are refused unless it is
`Unlocked`. `None` when the course does not lock chapters, or the host does not report it.

name.description:
The name of the exercise to be shown to the user.
Does not necessarily match or even contain the directory name.

tests.description: Descriptions of the tests that will be run for this exercise.

ExercisePackagingConfiguration.description: Represents configuration based on which submission may be packaged.

exercise_file_paths.description: Exercise folders or files which are copied from exercise template or clone.

plugin.description:
The language plugin that recognised the exercise: `python3`, `apache-maven`,
`apache-ant`, `csharp`, `make`, `r` or `No-Tests`. Absent only from CLIs older than this
field.

student_file_paths.description: Student folders or files which are copied from submission.

tests_timeout_ms.description:
How long the exercise's tests may run: its `.tmcproject.yml`'s `tests_timeout_ms`, else
[`DEFAULT_TESTS_TIMEOUT`]. Absent only from CLIs older than this field.

ExerciseProgress.description:
The current user's progress on a single exercise. `standing` is the "passed" signal;
`completed` is only the activity stage, which any graded submission can reach.

attempted.description: `true` once the user has started or submitted the exercise.

completed.description: `true` once the exercise reached the `Completed` activity stage.

exercise_locked.description:
`true` once the exercise takes no more submissions from the user, whatever its chapter's
locking status says. A submit fails with the `chapter-completed-and-locked` error kind
while the chapter is locked for the user, and with `exercise-locked` otherwise.

max_tries.description: How many graded submissions the exercise accepts per slide; `None` when unlimited.

pending_teacher_review.description:
What the user's points wait for when a teacher must review their answer first. While set,
`score_given` is `0.0` and `standing` is `Attempted`, even after a fully passing grading.

reviewing_stage.description:
Where the answer is in the exercise's peer, self or teacher review, which happens in the
course material. `None` while the user can still answer, and from a host that predates
the field.

score_given.description:
Points awarded to the user; `0.0` when the user has no state for the
exercise. Can be fractional (partial credit).

score_maximum.description: The maximum points obtainable from the exercise; can be `0`.

standing.description: `None` from a host that predates the field.

teacher_review.description: A teacher's grading that overrides the automatic score. `None` when there is none to show.

tries_left.description: How many of `max_tries` are left on the slide the user answers; `None` when unlimited.

ExerciseSlideSubmissionListItem.description:
A past submission or snapshot of the current user to an exercise. `id` is what
[`MoocClient::download_submission_files`] and [`MoocClient::share_submission`] take.

is_shared.description:
Whether the entry has a live share link, whatever its kind. `false` from a host that
predates the field.

kind.description: `submission` from a host that predates the field, which lists only submissions.

ExerciseStanding.description: Where the user stands on an exercise, as the host decides it.

oneOf.description: No graded submission and no try used.

Below full points with tries left, still being graded, in peer or self review, or waiting
for a teacher's review (`pending_teacher_review`).
A grading awarded full points.

Below full points (0 included), the try limit used up and no review pending, so the score
is final.
A value newer than this client.

exercise_page_url.description:
The exercise's course material page, where the submission's grading also shows. Set by
[`MoocClient::submit_exercise`], which has the exercise at hand; `None` otherwise, or when
the host reports no page.

slide_submission_id.description: Identifies the slide submission; what downloading and sharing take.

task_submission_id.description: Identifies the task submission; what grading is polled for.

ExerciseTaskSubmissionStatus.description: The grading status of a task submission, as polled after `submit`.

oneOf.description: The submission has no grading record yet.

A grading record exists. It may still be in progress; `grading_progress`
says how far it has got.

The submission belongs to an exam the user can still answer; its grading shows only
after that.
A status newer than this client.

ExerciseUpdates.description: What [`check_tmc_exercise_updates`] found among the local TMC exercises.

removed.description: Exercises the server no longer has. Their local copies are left in place and are never updated.

updated.description: Exercises whose server version differs from the local copy.

exercise_progress.description:
The user's progress on the whole exercise as of this poll; its `completed` is the
authoritative "passed" signal. `None` for an exam exercise or from a host that does not
report it.

feedback_text.description: Human-readable feedback, for a client to display as-is.

score_given.description:
Absent until grading has produced a value; a partial value while
`grading_progress` is still pending.

submission_page_url.description:
The exercise in the course material, where the latest submission and its grading show.
`None` for an exam exercise, and from a host that predates the field.

test_results.description:
The test run the grading was based on. `None` until grading has produced one, or when the
exercise service reported something else.

oneOf.description: The grading could not complete.
There is no grading process occurring; for example, the student has not yet made any submission.
Final Grade is pending, and it does require human intervention; if a Score value is present, it indicates the current value is partial and may be updated during the manual grading.
Final Grade is pending, but does not require manual intervention; if a Score value is present, it indicates the current value is partial and may be updated.
The grading process is completed; the score value, if any, represents the current Final Grade;
A value newer than this client.

GradingTestResult.description: The result of a single test case.

exception.description: Stack trace lines of a failure.

points.description: The points the test earned; empty when it failed.

GradingTestRun.description: The test run a grading was based on.

logs.description:
The run's output keyed by log type (e.g. `stdout`, `stderr`). Empty unless `status` is
`COMPILE_FAILED` or `GENERIC_ERROR`, where it holds the compiler or error output.

test_results.description: Empty when the tests did not run, e.g. on a compile failure.

GradingTestRunStatus.description: The overall status of a test run.

oneOf.description: For all other errors

The server answered 403: the user may not see what was asked for, such as a draft
course (courses.mooc.fi's `no_access`, or a 403 without a more specific key).
Not logged in, detected either by no token or 401 from server
Failed to connect to the TMC server, likely due to no internet connection
Client out of date
Invalid token

The user is not enrolled on the course this exercise belongs to
(backend `message_key: "not_enrolled"`, HTTP 422)

A submitted file expired before the submission naming it was accepted
(backend `message_key: "upload_expired"`, HTTP 422), even after one retry.

A submission named a file this user never uploaded for the exercise
(backend `message_key: "unknown_upload"`, HTTP 422). A client bug or tampering.
The user denied a device login in the browser.
A device login was not approved before its code expired.

The server answered 404: what was asked for does not exist, or not for this user. Also
a file courses.mooc.fi handed out a download URL for (an exercise's or submission's
files) that is missing from its file store.
A 404 for a request addressing one exercise is `ExerciseNotFound` instead.
The server answered with a 5xx status. Transient, so stored credentials are kept.

courses.mooc.fi answered 403 `insufficient_scope`: the access token lacks the
`exercise-services` scope. Says nothing about the course.

The server answered 404 to a request addressing one exercise: the exercise does not
exist, or not for this user.

courses.mooc.fi answered 429 (backend `message_key: "rate_limited"`): the user made too
many pastes of the exercise recently and should try again later.

A submission came after the exercise's deadline (its own, else its chapter's)
(backend `message_key: "deadline_passed"`, HTTP 422).

A submission came when the exercise had no tries left
(backend `message_key: "out_of_tries"`, HTTP 422).

The exercise's chapter has not opened yet
(backend `message_key: "chapter_not_open_yet"`, HTTP 403).

Chapter locking keeps the exercise's chapter closed until the previous chapters are
completed (backend `message_key: "chapter_not_unlocked_yet"`, HTTP 403).

The user completed and locked the exercise's chapter, which takes no more submissions
(backend `message_key: "chapter_completed_and_locked"`, HTTP 403).

The exercise takes no more submissions from the user, whatever its chapter's locking
status says (backend `message_key: "exercise_locked"`, HTTP 403).

The server refused the request as invalid (a 4xx with no more specific kind); retrying
the same request cannot help.

The server answered with something this version cannot read, e.g. a captive portal's
login page.
No answer before the timeout; the server may be slow rather than unreachable.

TLS failed, typically an untrusted certificate from a network security product or a
wrong system clock.
A proxy refused the connection or asked for credentials.

courses.mooc.fi's login service refused this client itself (e.g. `invalid_client`); the
user logging in again cannot fix it.

tmc.mooc.fi answered 401 to the courses.mooc.fi login, which courses.mooc.fi still
accepts.
tmc.mooc.fi could not confirm the courses.mooc.fi login with courses.mooc.fi right now.
A local settings, course or credentials file could not be read.
An archive is over a size or entry limit.

The exercise cannot be worked on in the editor: it has no editor task, several, or one of
another exercise service.
Another program holds a file the command needs (`path`).
The OS denied access to `path`.
`path` is longer than the file system allows.
The disk or the user's quota is full, or the file system is read-only.
A program needed to build or test the exercise is not installed or not found.
A freshly built program was blocked or removed, typically by antivirus software.

The exercises folder (`path`) is missing, e.g. on a drive that is not connected; it was
not recreated.
The folder the exercises folder was to be moved to is the exercises folder itself.
The folder the exercises folder was to be moved to is inside the exercises folder.

LocalExercise.description: An exercise in the projects directory, tagged with the backend it came from.

LocalMoocExercise.description: MOOC exercise inside the projects directory.

course-slug.description:
The course's on-disk directory name, derived from the course name and unique among the
local courses. Not the course's server-side `slug`.

exercise-slug.description:
The exercise's on-disk directory name, used as its slug (mirrors the TMC
slug); stable since names are unique per course.

LocalTmcExercise.description: TMC exercise inside the projects directory.

course-id.description: `None` for a course downloaded before course ids were recorded.

course-slug.description: The course's on-disk directory name, which is also its TMC slug.

ModelSolutionSpec.description:
Mirrors the `tmc` exercise service's `ModelSolutionSpec`
(`services/tmc/src/util/stateInterfaces.ts`). The backend forwards it once
the model solution may be revealed; the solution is an uploaded project
archive for both exercise types.

MoocClientUpdateData.description:
Per-exercise download progress, mirroring TMC's `ClientUpdateData`. Surfaced
by the CLI as a `mooc-client-update-data` status update; `id` is a [`Uuid`]
since mooc exercises are UUID-keyed.

ai_policy.description: `not_set` from a host that predates the field.

closed_at.description: When the course run ends or ended; it takes no new students from then on.

is_enrolled.description:
`Some(false)` for a course the user only teaches: submits to it fail with the
`not-enrolled` error kind. `None` from a host that predates the field.

is_staff.description: Staff get exercises of unopened chapters and model solutions whatever their progress.

language_code.description: IETF BCP 47 tag such as `fi-FI`. `None` from a host that predates the field.

language_group_id.description:
Shared by every language version of the course; each version is a separate course with
its own exercises.

moved_to_course_id.description: The language version the user moved to from this course, if they did.

successor_course_id.description: The course that continues this one after it closed, if its teacher named one.

url.description: The course material's front page. `None` from a host that predates the field.

MoocCurrentUser.description:
The courses.mooc.fi account a token acts for; a changed `id` after login means the
student switched accounts.

email.description: `None` from a host that predates the field.

name.description:
For showing which account is logged in. `None` when the user gave none, and from a host
that predates the field.

MoocDeviceLogin.description:
Payload of a `mooc-device-login` status update; a subset of the RFC 8628
device authorization response.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the device/user codes expire.

user_code.description: The code the user enters (or confirms) on the verification page.

verification_uri.description: URL the user opens to enter the `user_code`.

verification_uri_complete.description: URL that already includes the `user_code`, if the server provided one.

MoocDownloadFailure.description: Why a mooc exercise could not be downloaded.

oneOf.description: Not among the exercises of the course, the exam or any enrolled course.
Its chapter has not opened yet.
It is answered in the browser and has no project to download.
Its slide has more than one editor task; it is answered in the course material.
courses.mooc.fi's file store has no files for it.
The download could not be unpacked or written into the exercise folder.

MoocExam.description: An exam the user has started and can still answer.

answerable_until.description:
Answers are accepted until then: the end of the user's time or of the exam, whichever
comes first.

exercise-id.description:
The requested exercise's id (not the internal editor task id), so callers
can match each download/skip/failure to the exercise.

MoocExerciseUpdates.description:
What [`check_mooc_exercise_updates`] found among the local mooc exercises; like
[`ExerciseUpdates`] but keyed by exercise id.

removed.description:
Exercises their course no longer has. Their local copies are left in place and are never updated.
Exercises of a chapter that has not opened yet are absent from the course but not removed.

unchecked_courses.description:
Courses on disk that courses.mooc.fi refused to serve. `updated` and `removed` say nothing
about their exercises.

updated.description: Exercises whose server version differs from the local copy.

MoocOldSubmissionRestore.description: Outcome of restoring a past mooc submission.

oneOf.description: The submission's archive was overlaid on a fresh stub.

The host has no files for the submission, so nothing on disk was touched.
Only an exercise type with no files at all reaches this; a tmc submission
always has its archive, wherever it was made.

PasteResult.description: A shareable URL for a submission or snapshot.

PendingTeacherReview.description:
What a user's points on an exercise wait for when a teacher reviews answers before awarding
points.

oneOf.description:
The answer is graded, but its points come only after the user completes and locks the
exercise's chapter and a teacher reviews the answer. Submitting stays possible until then.
The answer waits for a teacher's review, and the exercise is locked.
A value newer than this client.

browser_test.description:
In-browser test config; omitted for editor exercises or when no script
was built.

RefreshData.description: Data from a finished course refresh.

RefreshExercise.description: An exercise from a finished course refresh.

ReviewingStage.description: Where an answer is in an exercise's review process. No stage takes new answers.

oneOf.description: The user must give peer reviews in the course material.
The user must review their own answer in the course material.
The user has given their reviews and waits for others to review their answer.
Reviews are done and points awarded; the answer is final.
The answer was locked with its chapter before any review.
The chapter was locked before the user answered.
A value newer than this client.

RunResult.description: The result of running an exercise's test suite against a submission.

logs.description:
Logs from the test run.
The key may be an arbitrary string identifying the type of log.

status.description: The overall status of a test run.

testResults.description: Whether each test passed and which points were awarded.

timedOutAfterMs.description:
Set when the tests were stopped for running longer than this many milliseconds: the
exercise's `tests_timeout_ms`, else 60000. The status is then `TESTS_FAILED`, with one
failing test named "Timeout test" whose message says so; an infinite loop is the usual
cause.

RunStatus.description: The overall status of a test run.

oneOf.description: The submission and tests compiled and all tests passed.
The submission and tests compiled but some tests failed.
The submission or tests did not compile.
The submission compiled but testrun was interrupted.

For when no other status seems suitable, or the language plugin has
suffered an internal error.
The command was ran without fatal errors
An unexpected issue occurred during the command

StatusUpdate.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

StatusUpdate2.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

StatusUpdate3.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

StatusUpdate4.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

oneOf.description: Per-exercise download progress for mooc's UUID-keyed exercises.

Emitted once at the start of `mooc login`, before the CLI blocks polling;
carries the URL and code the client shows the user.

StyleValidationResult.description: The result of a style check.

StyleValidationStrategy.description: Determines how style errors are handled.

Submission.description:
get /api/v8/courses/{course_id}/submissions
get /api/v8/courses/{course_id}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get /api/v8/courses/{course_id}/users/current/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/current/submissions
get /api/v8/org/{organization_slug}/courses/{course_name}/submissions
get /api/v8/org/{organization_slug}/courses/{course_name}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get /api/v8/org/{organization_slug}/courses/{course_name}/users/current/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/current/submissions

SubmissionKind.description: What an entry in a submissions list is.

oneOf.description: A graded submission.
An ungraded snapshot stored to be shared, by `mooc paste`.
An ungraded snapshot stored before local changes were discarded, by `--save-old-state`.
A value newer than this client.
The answer was rejected and the exercise reset, so the user can answer again.
A value newer than this client.

TeacherReview.description: A teacher's grading of the user's answer.

TestDesc.description: A description of an exercise's test case.

name.description:
The full name of the test.

If the language organises tests into suites or classes, it is customary
to name the test as "class_name.method_name".

points.description:
The list of point names that passing this test may give.

To obtain a point X, the user must pass all exercises that require point X.

TestResult.description: The result of a single test case.

points.description: List of points that were received from the exercise from passed tests.

TmcConfig.description: The main configuration file. A separate one is used for each client.

TmcDownloadFailure.description: Why a TMC exercise could not be downloaded.

oneOf.description: tmc.mooc.fi has no such exercise, or not for this user.
The download could not be unpacked or written into the exercise folder.

chapter.description: `None` for an exercise outside any chapter, or from a host that does not report it.

course_id.description:
Lets a client locate the exercise's course without a separate lookup. The nil UUID for an
exam exercise, which `exam_id` names instead.

deadline.description:
The effective deadline: the exercise's own, else its chapter's. Submissions are refused
from this moment on.

page_url.description:
The course material page the exercise is on, which also shows the student's latest
submission. `None` from a host that does not report it.

unsupported.description:
Why the exercise cannot be downloaded to work on in an editor: `browser-only` or
`several-editor-tasks`, the failure `download-or-update-course-exercises` would report.
Absent when it can be downloaded, and from CLIs older than this field.

exercise_service_slug.description:
The exercise service that owns the task. Specs are read only for [`TMC_SERVICE_SLUG`];
any other service's task has neither spec.

instructions_text.description:
The plain text of `assignment`, one entry per block that has text, nested blocks after
their parent. Absent when it has none, and from CLIs older than this field.

extra_exercise_files.description:
A list of files or directories that will always be considered exercise files.
`extra_student_files` takes precedence if a file is both an extra student file and an extra exercise file.

extra_student_files.description: A list of files or directories that will always be considered student files.

fail_on_valgrind_error.description: If set, Valgrind errors will be considered test errors.

force_update.description: A list of files that should always be overwritten by updates even if they are student files.

minimum_python_version.description: If set, will cause an error telling the student to update their Python if their version is older than the minimum.

sandbox_image.description: Overrides the default sandbox image. e.g. `eu.gcr.io/moocfi-public/tmc-sandbox-python:latest`

submission_size_limit_mb.description: Overrides the default archive size limit (500 Mb).

tests_timeout_ms.description: If set, tests are forcibly stopped after this duration.

TmcStyleValidationResult.description: The result of a style check.

TmcStyleValidationStrategy.description: Determines how style errors are handled.
